facts: Last night the class had a sleepover at the Millbrook Town Museum. The children slept in their sleeping bags in the Dinosaur Hall.
The little clockwork model of the town's old steam train lives in a glass case in the Railway Room. It has a tiny brass bell on its engine that goes 'ting' when the train is moved.
Mr. Bell, the night guard, saw the train in its case on his round at nine o'clock last night.
At seven o'clock this morning Mr. Bell found the lid of the case open and the train gone.
Breakfast is at eight, and the museum opens to visitors at ten.
Mila was seen by the train case early this morning, and everybody is whispering that she took it.

timeline: Friday 9:00 pm: Mr. Bell hands every child a numbered museum torch with new batteries and writes the numbers on his clipboard. Ravi gets torch number 7. The train is in its glass case. Lights out in the Dinosaur Hall.
Bedtime: Ravi tells Mila that his grandad drove the real steam train long ago, and that Grandad is poorly at home and cannot come to the museum to see the model.

11:15 pm: Finn feels homesick. He creeps out of his sleeping bag, through the Railway Room, where the train still sits in its case, to Mr. Bell's desk in the Entrance Hall. Mr. Bell gives him warm milk in a cup with FINN written on it and lets him sit beside him. Finn asks Mr. Bell to keep it a secret.
11:15 pm: Zara, in the next sleeping bag, sees Finn go and drifts back to sleep.
About 11:25 pm: Zara half wakes and sees a torch beam bob out of the Dinosaur Hall from the end of the row, where Ravi's sleeping bag with the rocket pillow is.

11:30 pm: Ravi lifts the lid of the glass case off its brass hook and takes the train. Its little bell goes 'ting'. He wraps it in his red woolly scarf, and red fluff catches on the hook. Mr. Bell, with Finn beside him at the desk, hears the ting and small feet pattering towards the cloakroom, and thinks a child is going to the toilets.

11:31 pm: Hearing Mr. Bell's chair creak, Ravi panics and drops torch number 7. It rolls under the bench by the case, still switched on. Ravi runs to the cloakroom in the dark, pushes the wrapped train into his blue rucksack with the rocket patch, writes a card 'For Grandad. Back on Monday.', and creeps back to bed. Bits of red fluff drop on the cloakroom floor under the pegs.

11:45 pm: Finn walks back to the Dinosaur Hall through the Railway Room in the dark and loses one of his green dinosaur slippers on the doormat. Back in bed, he begs Zara to say he was with her all night so nobody knows he was homesick.

6:30 am: Mila creeps into the Railway Room with a pencil and paper to finish drawing the train as a present for the museum. The case is already open and empty. She scribbles a drawing of the empty case with '6:30 IT'S GONE!', gets frightened that she will be blamed, drops the paper and hurries out. Mr. Bell sees her hurry out with only a pencil in her hand.

7:00 am: Mr. Bell does his morning round, finds the case open and the train gone, and wakes the children. Torch number 7 is still glowing weakly under the bench, nearly worn out after shining all night.
Morning: the train is found safe and unbroken in Ravi's rucksack, and goes back in its case before the museum opens at ten.
truth.motive: Ravi's grandad drove the real steam train long ago and is too poorly to come to the museum. Ravi took the little model to take home and show Grandad, meaning to bring it back on Monday. He knew it was not his to take, so he hid it and let Mila take the blame because he was scared of getting into trouble.

railway_room.name: The Railway Room
facts: The Railway Room has old railway signs on the walls and a painting of the town's steam train puffing over a bridge.
A glass case on a wooden stand sits in the middle of the room, with a velvet stand inside for the little train.
A long wooden bench sits beside the case.
One door leads to the Dinosaur Hall, one to the Entrance Hall and one to the cloakroom.

spots.name: the doormat by the Entrance Hall door

dinosaur_hall.name: The Dinosaur Hall
facts: A huge dinosaur skeleton towers over the middle of the hall.
A row of children's sleeping bags lies along the wall, with pillows and teddies.
Tall windows let in the grey morning light.

entrance_hall.name: The Entrance Hall
facts: The Entrance Hall has the big front doors and a ticket counter.
Mr. Bell's guard's desk stands by the front doors, with a lamp and a comfy chair.
From the guard's desk you can hear sounds from the Railway Room next door.

cloakroom.name: The Cloakroom
facts: The cloakroom has a row of pegs with the children's coats and rucksacks hanging on them.
The toilets are through a door at the back.
A rack of wellies stands by the wall.

bell.name: Mr. Bell
bell.personality: A big, slow, kindly night guard who loves the museum and keeps his promises. He is upset the train is gone, but he never shouts.

demeanor.open: Calm and helpful, rubbing his sleepy eyes after the long night.
demeanor.guarded: Kind but careful. He made a promise to a child and does not want to break it unless it really matters.

knows.fact: Mr. Bell has been the night guard at the Millbrook Town Museum for twenty years.
The toilets are at the back of the cloakroom.
The children slept in the Dinosaur Hall, under the big dinosaur skeleton.

appearance: Mr. Bell is a tall, round man with a grey moustache.
He wears a dark blue guard's uniform with shiny buttons and a big torch on his belt.

zara.name: Zara
zara.personality: Bouncy, loud and very loyal. She keeps her friends' secrets even when she should not, and she is a terrible liar.

demeanor.open: Chatty and excited about the mystery.
demeanor.guarded: Too quick to answer, with her fingers crossed behind her back.
demeanor.cleared: Relieved to stop pretending, and keen to help.

knows.fact: Zara slept in the sleeping bag next to Finn's.
Mila loves drawing and carries a pencil everywhere.

appearance: Zara is a girl with bouncy curls tied up in a bright yellow band.
She wears stripy pyjamas and odd socks.

finn.name: Finn
finn.personality: Small, sweet and shy. He wants everyone to think he is brave, and he would hate anyone to know he missed home.

demeanor.guarded: Pink in the face, shifting from foot to foot and looking anywhere but at you.
demeanor.shaken: Quiet and blinking hard, wondering if everyone will laugh.
demeanor.cleared: Shy but happy. He is glad it is out and nobody laughed.

knows.fact: Finn has never slept away from home before this sleepover.
Mr. Bell is the night guard and sits at the desk in the Entrance Hall.

appearance: Finn is a small boy with sticking-up red hair and freckles.

mila.name: Mila
mila.personality: Quiet, dreamy and arty. She loves drawing more than anything. When she is frightened she goes very still and says as little as she can.

demeanor.guarded: Very still and quiet, sitting on her sleeping bag and hugging her knees.
demeanor.shaken: Teary. She is scared nobody will believe her.
demeanor.cleared: Relieved and smiling a little. She wants to finish her train drawing.

knows.fact: Mila wants to be an artist when she grows up.
Mila slept in the middle of the row of sleeping bags in the Dinosaur Hall.

appearance: Mila is a girl with a long dark plait.
She wears a blue nightie with little stars on it and has a pencil tucked behind her ear.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.personality: Kind, dreamy and mad about trains. He loves his grandad very much. He is not used to fibbing, so he fibs badly and talks too fast.

demeanor.guarded: Too cheerful, talking fast and keeping close to the coat pegs.
demeanor.shaken: His voice goes wobbly and he keeps glancing at the pegs.
demeanor.cornered: His bottom lip trembles and he stares at his feet.
demeanor.cleared: Tearful but relieved. He is sorry Mila was blamed and wants the train back in its case.

knows.fact: Ravi knows lots of facts about steam trains, like how they burn coal to make steam.
Ravi slept at the end of the row in the Dinosaur Hall, with his rocket pillow.

appearance: Ravi is a boy with short black hair and big brown eyes.
He wears pyjamas with little trains on them.

clue_torch_on.fact: Under the bench beside the train case lies a museum torch with the number 7 painted on its handle. It is still switched on, but its light is only a weak yellow glow, nearly worn out. Someone left it shining for many hours, all through the night.

clue_red_wool.fact: The lid of the glass case has been lifted off its little brass hook, and the velvet stand inside is empty. Bits of fluffy red wool are caught on the brass hook, as if something red and woolly brushed against it.

clue_finn_slipper.fact: A green dinosaur slipper lies on the doormat by the door to the Entrance Hall. The name FINN is written inside it.

source.spot: the doormat by the Entrance Hall door

clue_mila_drawing.fact: A sheet of paper with Mila's name on it lies on the floor beside the case. It is a pencil drawing of the glass case with its lid open and nothing inside, and in wobbly letters it says '6:30 IT'S GONE!'. When Mila drew it at half past six, the train was already gone.

clue_empty_torch_spot.fact: Every sleeping bag in the row has a museum torch beside it, except the sleeping bag at the end with the rocket pillow, which is Ravi's. Ravi's torch is missing.

clue_dino_sign.fact: A sign on the dinosaur skeleton says it was dug up near Millbrook a hundred years ago and carried to the museum by the town's old steam train.

clue_finn_cup.fact: On the guard's desk are Mr. Bell's big mug and a small cup with FINN written on it in pen. A little cold milk is left at the bottom of Finn's cup. Finn was at the guard's desk in the night.

clue_torch_list.fact: Mr. Bell's clipboard says: 'Torches handed out at 9 pm, all with new batteries. Number 2: Zara. Number 3: Mila. Number 5: Finn. Number 7: Ravi.' Torch number 7 is Ravi's.

clue_wool_trail.fact: Little bits of fluffy red wool lie on the cloakroom floor under the pegs. They lead to a blue rucksack with a rocket patch and a name tag that says RAVI. The rocket rucksack is bulging, as if something lumpy is packed inside.

clue_welly_rack.fact: The welly rack holds rows of children's wellies, all dry and neatly paired, with nothing hidden in them.

clue_train_found.fact: Inside Ravi's rocket rucksack, wrapped in a red woolly scarf, is the little clockwork steam train, safe and not broken at all. Tucked beside it is a card in Ravi's writing: 'For Grandad. Back on Monday.'

bell_found.fact: Mr. Bell says the train was in its case on his nine o'clock round. At seven this morning he found the lid open and the train gone. He sat at his desk in the Entrance Hall all night in between.

bell_saw_mila.fact: Mr. Bell says that at half past six this morning he saw Mila hurry out of the Railway Room in her nightie, looking frightened.

bell_ting.fact: Mr. Bell says that at half past eleven last night he heard the train's little brass bell go 'ting' in the Railway Room, then small quick feet pattering towards the cloakroom. He thought it was a child going to the toilets. That ting must have been when the train was taken.

bell_mila_hands.fact: Mr. Bell says that when Mila hurried out of the Railway Room at half past six, she had only a pencil in her hand. Her nightie has no pockets, and she was carrying no train.

bell_promise_tell.fact: When Finn's name comes up, Mr. Bell taps the side of his nose and glances at the small cup on his desk.

bell_finn.fact: Mr. Bell says Finn came to his desk at quarter past eleven because he was homesick, and sat beside him drinking warm milk until quarter to twelve. Finn was right next to him when the train's bell went 'ting' at half past eleven, so Finn cannot have taken it. Finn asked him to keep it a secret.

line.text: They tell Mr. Bell that keeping Finn's secret could get Finn blamed, so it is all right to tell.

zara_alibi.fact: Zara says Finn was with her all night in the Dinosaur Hall, in the sleeping bag next to hers, whispering spooky stories. She says he never got up once.
zara_alibi.why: Finn begged her to say it so nobody would find out he was homesick, and she is loyal to her friend.

zara_fingers.fact: While she talks about Finn, Zara keeps her fingers crossed behind her back and goes a bit pink.

zara_retracts.fact: Zara admits Finn was not with her all night: he crept off at quarter past eleven, and she fell back asleep. A little later she half woke and saw a torch beam bob out of the Dinosaur Hall from the end of the row, where Ravi's sleeping bag with the rocket pillow is.

line.text: They notice her crossed fingers and tell her that a good friend tells the truth when somebody could be blamed.

zara_mila_plan.fact: Zara says that at bedtime Mila said she would get up early to finish her drawing of the little train, as a present for the museum.

finn_alibi.fact: Finn says he stayed in his sleeping bag next to Zara all night, telling stories, and never went anywhere.
finn_alibi.why: He is embarrassed that he was homesick and does not want anyone to laugh at him.

finn_one_slipper.fact: Finn is wearing only one green dinosaur slipper, and he keeps his bare foot tucked behind the other one.

finn_admits.fact: Finn admits that at quarter past eleven he got up because he missed home. He went through the Railway Room, where the train was still in its case, to Mr. Bell's desk, and sat with Mr. Bell drinking warm milk until quarter to twelve. On the way back in the dark he lost a slipper. He asked Zara to say he was with her.

line.text: They ask about his missing slipper and tell him lots of people feel homesick, even grown-ups.

mila_in_bed.fact: Mila says she stayed in her sleeping bag all night and all morning until Mr. Bell woke everyone at seven. She says she never went into the Railway Room.
mila_in_bed.why: She saw the empty case and is frightened that everyone will think she took the train.

mila_smudge.fact: Mila's fingers are grey with pencil smudges, and she keeps glancing at the door to the Railway Room.

mila_admits.fact: Mila admits she crept into the Railway Room at half past six to finish drawing the train as a present for the museum. The case was already open and empty. She scribbled what she saw, then got scared she would be blamed, dropped her drawing and ran back to bed.

line.text: They ask about her pencil-smudged fingers and promise they will listen before deciding anything.

mila_ravi_grandad.fact: Mila says that at bedtime Ravi told her his grandad drove the real steam train long ago, and that Grandad is poorly at home and cannot come to the museum to see the little model.

reached.about: who else loves the little train

ravi_asleep.fact: Ravi says he fell fast asleep at lights out and did not wake up once until seven o'clock. He says he never left the Dinosaur Hall in the night.
ravi_asleep.why: He took the train in the night and is scared of getting into trouble.

ravi_blames_mila.fact: Ravi says it must have been Mila who took the train, because she is always staring at it and Mr. Bell saw her by the case.
ravi_blames_mila.why: Pointing at Mila keeps everyone from looking at him.

ravi_pegs.fact: Ravi stands right in front of the rucksack pegs and will not move away from them, and he keeps glancing over his shoulder at them.

ravi_admits_up.fact: Ravi admits he did get up in the night with his torch, number 7, to look at the little train in the dark. He says he dropped his torch in the Railway Room and ran back to bed without it.

line.text: They ask Ravi why he keeps guarding the rucksack pegs, and whether he really stayed asleep all night.

ravi_drops_mila.fact: Ravi says that if the case was already empty when Mila came at half past six, then it cannot have been Mila. He says he is sorry he said it.

ravi_confession.fact: Ravi says he took the train at half past eleven. He wrapped it in his red scarf and hid it in his rocket rucksack in the cloakroom, to take home and show his grandad, who drove the real steam train and is too poorly to visit. He meant to bring it back on Monday. He dropped his torch when he heard Mr. Bell's chair creak.

finn_alibi_early.text: Finn was in his sleeping bag beside Zara all night, so he cannot have taken the train.

finn_cleared.text: Finn is cleared: he was sitting beside Mr. Bell at the guard's desk when the train's bell went 'ting' at half past eleven.

mila_cleared.text: Mila is cleared: when she came to the case at half past six it was already empty, and she carried nothing out but a pencil.

mila_explained.text: Mila was by the case early in the morning only because she went to finish her drawing of the train.
mila_explained.resolves: red herring: Mila seen by the case

slipper_explained.text: Finn's slipper was on the Railway Room doormat because he walked through in the dark on his way to and from Mr. Bell's desk.
slipper_explained.resolves: red herring: Finn's slipper in the Railway Room

culprit_ravi.text: Ravi took the train in the night, dropped his torch, and hid the train in his rocket rucksack.

why_ravi.text: Ravi took the train to show his poorly grandad, who drove the real steam train, and meant to bring it back.
